records.claim: Using more than the recommended amount of docusate sodium can lower the levels of magnesium in a person’s blood. There is one reported case of low magnesium levels in a newborn that was linked to overuse of docusate sodium by the woman who was pregnant. The baby’s main symptom was jitteriness, which went away by age 2 days. There have been no reported problems linked to the use of recommended amounts of docusate sodium in pregnancy.
records.source_section: Does taking docusate sodium in pregnancy increase the chance of other pregnancy-related problems?
